notes.title: New Game on the horizon!
notes.notes:
Summer is knocking on our door, and with it, a brand new game from us! Strawberry Chocolate is everything you never knew you needed! Especially if you didn't know you needed to be marooned on an asteroid in the middle of nowhere to mine precious crystals and fight off vicious slugs! 

Check out the store page to find a brand new trailer and all the info you'd ever need!

notes.title: The Little Update
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

With today's update, we release a handful of small fixes to enrich the overall experience. Enjoy!

-fixed one wall texture that behaved like a floor texture
-fixed a large screen tv texture that behaved like a floor texture
-altered the title menu window to be transparent
-fixed a bug that didn't properly reset character levels at a certain point in the game
